summary: All five issues from the previous review are resolved. (1) HIGH: ai_run.py is committed — git status shows no unstaged changes, and commits c73a2b7 and c2ae1d6 confirm the epic pipeline and fix are both in git history. (2) HIGH: Routing bug in epic_next_action is fixed — the current_stage == 'epic_design_fix_prepare' and current_stage == 'epic_design_fix_complete' guards are now placed before the review_decision guard (lines 1611-1615), so fix-loop routing correctly returns 'epic-design-fix-complete' when epic_review.json has been archived/deleted. (3) MEDIUM: epic_planner.md has no uncommitted or staged modifications. (4) LOW: Dead-code duplicate breakdown branch is removed; only one check remains, correctly nested inside the story-map-absent block. (5) LOW: Redundant build_epic_review_fix_context call is removed from epic_design_fix_prepare; the function now checks fix_ctx.exists() and appends it to extra_paths, relying on the context already written by epic_review_complete. No new issues were introduced by the fix round. Acceptance criteria are satisfied. Approving.
